title: FITRR role players and contextual business roles
meaning: Role is associated with RolePlayer by Player; roles and the entities playing them remain distinct. Role generalizes asset, system, settlement, regulatory-reporting, trade and account roles. SecuritiesPartyRole and IssuerRole specialize AssetPartyRole; RegistrarRole further specializes SecuritiesPartyRole. SubmittingPartyRole specializes SystemPartyRole, buyer/seller specialize trade role, account owner and investment-account party specialize account role, and investor specializes investment-account party role. No message direction or permanent institution identity follows from this hierarchy.

title: FITRR regulatory data identification and financial-asset context
meaning: The complete model connects securities identification, trading and settlement places, issuance and validity periods, party and organisation identities, trade identifiers and parties, governing agreement, system and clearing-system context, securities quantities, debt and interest calculations, asset classification, derivatives and price/benchmark relationships. Security identification has a self-association for prime and related identification. Issuance has two distinct quantity associations; debt also has separate denomination and increment associations. Derivative–Asset is displayed with a hollow-triangle generalization and UnderlyingAsset association sharing the same vertical route. FullBusinessModel!A1545:F1546 independently establishes both relationships, so the reconstruction separates the overlapping route into two lines rather than treating UnderlyingAsset as an inheritance label. Security–Asset inheritance exists in the workbook definition but is not drawn in this view and is not added to the source reconstruction. The figure is a conceptual reference model, not a database or business-message flow.
